harness.details: Root test suite executes the evaluation and evidence tests. The mocked-runner test evaluates all 21 cases; its 16 provider calls exclude controlled request/provider and validator-boundary fixtures.

evidence_privacy.details: Automated evidence/log tests passed; exact dataset statements were checked across retained evidence. Two initial-generation diagnostic logs had synthetic statements redacted and are labeled. No checked provider markers or API-key patterns were found. .env was not read and is not tracked.

SC-001.basis: Schema and synthetic contract tests pass, but there is no actual-model result set to establish conformance of model-generated evaluation outputs.

SC-002.basis: The live OpenAI evaluation and its fixed-threshold scores are unavailable.

SC-003.basis: Automated privacy tests check operational logs and retained evidence; the app has no transaction persistence layer.

SC-004.basis: Synthetic integration and invariant tests cover multiple-transaction rejection and independent corrected requests.

SC-005.basis: No 10-participant first-use study or participant measurements were performed.

SC-006.basis: No live 63-request latency run or timing measurements were performed.

SC-007.basis: Synthetic security tests pass with injected fake providers, but actual-model prompt-injection behavior was not evaluated.

model_evaluation.reason: OPENAI_API_KEY was unavailable in the process environment. No .env file was accessed and no live API call was made.

SC-005.pass_threshold: At least 9 of 10 complete correctly without assistance in 60 seconds or less.

SC-006.pass_threshold: At least 60 of 63 requests render a result or safe failure within 30 seconds.

currency_registry_qualification.details: The 156-code ICU-derived implementation snapshot is not an exact match to the recorded SIX List One XML revision Pblshd=2026-09-17. The documented differences include SVC, XCG, VED, and ANG. No currency codes, labels, or schema were changed.

known_limitations: The 21 synthetic cases do not establish comprehensive real-world accuracy or robustness.
Actual model semantic performance and availability have not been measured.
Prompt-injection defenses reduce risk but do not guarantee immunity.
Provider retention, processing, deletion, and regional terms require current official verification.
Human usability and live latency acceptance have not been measured.
residual_risks: Real model behavior may differ from mocked-provider tests.
External provider failures, policy changes, and model availability are outside local automated validation.
No human acceptance decision is recorded.

readiness.ready_for_demonstration: CONDITIONAL; requires configured provider access for live AI behavior, which was not tested here.
readiness.ready_for_final_academic_submission: NO; live model evaluation, required studies, human acceptance, and final quickstart validation remain outstanding.
